Cluster Diagnostics

Source: R/cluster_diagnostics.R
cluster_diagnostics.Rd

cluster_diagnostics() collects the quality measures of a clustering in one net_cluster_diagnostics object, laid out the same way whichever route produced the clusters: a distance clustering from build_clusters(), a mixed Markov model from build_mmm() or cluster_mmm(), the netobject_group that cluster_network() or build_network() builds from one of them, or the net_mmm_clustering attribute of such a group. It packages what the fit already computed and adds only the per-cluster summaries the fit does not store (silhouette means and mean within-cluster distances for a distance clustering, the classification error within each cluster for a mixture); it does not refit.

For a distance clustering it reports the average silhouette width, overall and per cluster, and each cluster's mean within-cluster distance. For a mixture it reports each cluster's average posterior probability (AvePP) and mixing proportion, the overall AvePP, the normalised entropy of the posterior probabilities (0 when every sequence is assigned with certainty, 1 when all assignments are equally likely; the reverse of the relative entropy often reported for latent class models), the classification error (the expected share of sequences misclassified when each is assigned to its most likely cluster: one minus the largest posterior, averaged over all sequences and over each cluster's members, so it equals one minus the AvePP; Vermunt & Magidson, 2005), and the log-likelihood with BIC, AIC and ICL.

These measures describe how cleanly one solution separates the sequences; none of them picks the number of clusters. Compare solutions with cluster_choice() for distance clustering or compare_mmm() for mixtures, and build the clusters' networks with build_network() on the clustering to see how they differ, with bootstrap_network() for how stable their edges are.

Usage

cluster_diagnostics(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'net_cluster_diagnostics'
print(x, digits = 3L, ...)

# S3 method for class 'net_cluster_diagnostics'
plot(x, type = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'net_cluster_diagnostics'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

x

The clustering: a net_clustering, a net_mmm, a netobject_group carrying a clustering (built by cluster_network() or by build_network() from a net_clustering or net_mmm), or a net_mmm_clustering. A netobject_group without a clustering, and any other object, raise an error. For the print() and plot() methods: a net_cluster_diagnostics.

...

Not used: an extra argument raises an error, here and in the print() and summary() methods. For plot(): further arguments for the clustering's own plot() method, such as combined.

digits

For print(): decimal places of the silhouette widths, distances, AvePP, entropy and information criteria, a non-negative whole number. Default 3. Percentages are always shown to one decimal.

type

For plot(): the view, passed to the clustering's own plot() method. Default NULL, which draws "silhouette" for a distance clustering and "posterior" for a mixture. A distance clustering also takes "mds", "heatmap" and "predictors" (see build_clusters()); a mixture takes "covariates", with "predictors" accepted for it when the source is a net_mmm_clustering (see build_mmm()).

object

For the summary() method: a net_cluster_diagnostics.

Value

A net_cluster_diagnostics object. print() shows the numbers of sequences and clusters (with the method and dissimilarity of a distance clustering, or the number of states of a mixture), the overall quality measures, the information criteria of a mixture, one row per cluster, and the covariates of the fit, if any; plot() draws the clustering's own views. The object's fields:

family

"distance" or "mmm".

k, n, sizes

Number of clusters, number of sequences, and the cluster sizes.

per_cluster

Data frame with one row per cluster; its columns depend on the family. Distance: cluster, size, pct, mean_within_dist, sil_mean. Mixture: cluster, size, pct, mix_pct, avepp, class_err_pct. pct, mix_pct and class_err_pct are in percent.

overall

List of the family's summary measures: silhouette for distance; avepp_overall, entropy and classification_error (a proportion) for a mixture.

ics

For a mixture, a list with BIC, AIC, ICL and log_likelihood; NULL for distance.

metadata

The settings of the fit. Distance: method, dissimilarity, weighted, lambda, medoids, covariates. Mixture: states, n_states, iterations, converged, covariates.

source

The clustering object itself, which plot() draws without recomputing anything.

For print(): the input, invisibly. For plot(): what the clustering's own plot() method returns, a ggplot object (invisibly) or, for the covariate views with combined = FALSE, a list of ggplot objects named by cluster (invisibly). For summary(): the per-cluster table described under per_cluster, a data frame with one row per cluster.

References

Vermunt, J. K., & Magidson, J. (2005). Latent GOLD 4.0 User's Guide. Statistical Innovations.

See also

build_clusters, build_mmm, cluster_choice, compare_mmm for k-sweep model selection (MMM only).

Examples

seqs <- data.frame(V1 = sample(c("A","B","C"), 30, TRUE),
                   V2 = sample(c("A","B","C"), 30, TRUE))
cl <- build_clusters(seqs, k = 2, method = "ward.D2")
cluster_diagnostics(cl)
#> Cluster Diagnostics (distance) [ward.D2 / hamming]
#>   Sequences: 30  |  Clusters: 2
#>   Quality: silhouette = 0.463
#> 
#>   Cluster  N           Mean within-dist  Silhouette
#>   1        14 (46.7%)  1.132             0.283
#>   2        16 (53.3%)  0.608             0.620
# \donttest{
fit <- cluster_mmm(seqs, k = 2, n_starts = 1, max_iter = 20, seed = 1)
cluster_diagnostics(fit)
#> Cluster Diagnostics (mmm) [k = 2]
#>   Sequences: 30  |  Clusters: 2  |  States: 3
#>   Quality: AvePP = 0.946  |  Entropy = 0.287  |  Class.Err = 5.4%
#>   ICs: LL = -56.481  |  BIC = 170.782  |  AIC = 146.962  |  ICL = 174.190
#> 
#>   Cluster  N           Mix%   AvePP  Class.Err%
#>   1        21 (70.0%)  67.5%  0.943   5.7%
#>   2        9 (30.0%)   32.5%  0.952   4.8%
summary(cluster_diagnostics(fit))
#>   cluster size pct  mix_pct     avepp class_err_pct
#> 1       1   21  70 67.48869 0.9428695      5.713045
#> 2       2    9  30 32.51131 0.9519734      4.802660
# }
